messages:
erin_dev: Quick q — who should be the 'deploy-ambassador' for tonight's canary? Need someone with MFA + prod-claim rights. @sam_oncall @maria_sre any volunteers? Also: rollbacks pinned to v1.12.3, want version pin in release notes.

sam_oncall: I can take 19:00-21:00 but my MFA token rotates at 21:00 and I won’t be near phone after that. Can we do a JIT handoff or rotate the ambassador key before expiry?

maria_sre: JIT's fine but FYI our JIT approval flow needs a manager thumbs-up in the 15m window. For a smooth handoff I prefer rotating the ambassador binding so deploy-bot doesn't block.

john_release: We have a k8s role binding `role:deploy-ambassador` but pressing prod also requires membership in `group:deployers-prod` + MFA. Ops can apply a temporary binding. Example command (run from infra machine):
```
kubectl apply -f ambassador-binding-19-23.yaml
# or gcloud iam roles add-iam-policy-binding --role=roles/deployAmbassador --member=user:sam@redwood.dev
```
If you want, I can schedule the rebind at 20:45 so Sam's token is refreshed before handoff.

sam_oncall: Can deploy-bot accept a claim that includes the user's MFA timestamp? If bot can verify token TTL, we can avoid manual rebinds.

deploy-bot: NOTICE: deploy-bot requires valid MFA check on claim. Claims without MFA fail with code: 403:mfacheck_failed. Docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/releases/deploy-ambassador#claims

maria_sre: Plan proposal: sam 19-21, erin 21-23. John will rebind Sam at 20:45 to extend role for the final 15m, then revoke. If rollback needed, use pinned tag `release/v1.12.3-pin` and notify #incidents + eng-oncall. Everyone ok? :white_check_mark:

erin_dev: SGTM. I'll add a short section to release notes with the pinned tag, rollback commands, and a one-line checklist item: `check-mfa --user $USER`. Also noting the exact time windows.

john_release: I'll run the role rebind at 20:45 and leave a comment in the release doc. Adding calendar invite for handoff.

maria_sre: Adding a devex ticket to make deploy-bot auto-reject claims older than 5m and to surface MFA TTL in the UI. That should reduce manual swaps next time. :thumbsup:
